name: Fintan mac Bóchra
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fintan mac Bochra was the most ancient of Irishmen. He was the only person to survive the great flood. The flood brought the seafaring queen Cesair and fifty women to Ireland. Only three men accompanied the women. Two of them perished of embraces. Fintan fled to save himself. He then changed into many forms. He wore the shape of a one-eyed salmon, an eagle, and a hawk. Bards such as Amairgin and Tuan Mac Cairill also changed shape. Several divinities shared this skill.

okr.objective: Fintan mac Bochra is the ancient Irishman who outlived the great flood.
